changes: Track the complete in-flight memory monitor task; retain the existing single-sample concurrency guard.
After worker close, await output writes and the monitor task before terminal result/outcome publication and diagnostic-lock release.
Preserve monitor errors after worker exit as failed attempts, recording only Error.name in monitor_error_type; retain raw worker events and original finish_reason.
Clear interval and process/request/kill timers using the existing exit/close/finally ordering; no new timeout or PID-based kill path.

checks.meaning: Actual baseline runner published outcome while a controlled memory append was pending; two barrier scenarios fail at premature terminal publication.
Initial green; test later had one unused constant removed for final lint.

Exact final author test and implementation: delayed success, late append rejection, no-pending-sample exit. Checks real diagnostic lock, terminal-write ordering, failure metadata and autonomous bounded exit.
Existing author lifecycle tests, current run: queued request timer race, stdout/stderr caps/backpressure, stubborn worker termination, UTF-8 and experiment-lock boundaries.
Scoped ESLint for the two final changed code/test files.

boundary.fixture: Owned temporary roots, copied development input/runtime code/policy only; finite local Node worker, fake sysctl, delayed fs.appendFile through preload. No actual Python model process or network request.

limits: This author check is not the independent peer review or root integration/full-project check.
Real machine memory pressure, actual model inference and real experimental freeze publication were not re-run.
The drain intentionally waits for filesystem append settlement and preserves the existing bounded sysctl calls; it does not claim recovery from an indefinitely wedged kernel/filesystem.
An I/O error message/path is intentionally not logged; monitor_error_type and stop_reason identify failure without exposing private paths.
The final runtime hash must be bound by the parent current-code freeze dependencies; historical freeze/result/label artifacts stay unchanged.
